text:
maya: Heads-up — during the customer sync today several accounts asked for 'session-scoped routing' (competitor has it). They framed it as parity ask and a blocker for renewals.
liam: Do we have telemetry on how often customers need it vs our current per-request routing? :thinking:
maya: Not direct metric. Sales pulled 4 accounts that flagged it. Risk of churn for two at renewal window.
sam: Engineering FYI: building full session-scoped routing is ~2 sprints + infra change. Could do a shim (sticky cookie + routing policy) in 1 sprint with caveats.
azra: If we can't promise parity by renewal it kills the deal. Could we offer 'limited preview' for those accounts?
jonah: Proposal: ship shim as 'compat toggle' behind feature flag for Dedicated/Private only first. Acceptance criteria: (1) consistent session routing 95% stability; (2) docs + migration guide; (3) fallback to per-request on error. Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% and customer-by-customer opt-in.
maya: That sounds reasonable. Need product ROI calc vs delaying other items (Optimize suggestions).
liam: Tradeoff: parity reduces sales friction but costs us ~2 dev-weeks and blockers for batching improvements (Optimize).
sam: Also needs tests: load-testing with KV cache behavior. I can carve one engineer for a sprint if we drop a minor perf story.
azra: I'll coordinate with the two renewal customers. If we can promise 'limited preview' by EOW next month it's enough to extend.
maya: OK next steps: Sam to scope concretely (task + rough estimate) by Thu, Jonah to draft acceptance criteria & docs outline, Azra to secure sign-off from customers. I'll escalate to Eng leadership if estimate > 2 sprints.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag framework update (no-prod).
jonah: Quick note on messaging: avoid saying 'parity' publicly. Call it 'session affinity beta' and highlight latency/throughput constraints.
